mcat_description.short: Dome Shelters are prefabricated, dome-shaped structural enclosures with a steel or aluminium frame covered in PVC fabric, FRP panels, or polycarbonate sheeting, sold as complete modular units or custom-built installations for outdoor use.
mcat_description.long: Dome Shelters are self-supporting, curved prefabricated structures based on geodesic, hemispherical, or semi-circular geometry, fabricated using galvanised steel or aluminium alloy frames covered with PVC-coated fabric, FRP panels, polycarbonate sheets, or tensile membrane. The dome geometry distributes structural loads evenly across the surface, providing high resistance to wind, rain, and snow without internal support columns, resulting in a large, column-free interior space. In the Indian market, these structures are supplied as modular bolt-together kits or as turnkey fabrication-and-installation projects, with diameters typically ranging from 3 metres to 50 metres depending on application. Primary buyers include hospitality and glamping resort developers, event management companies, schools and institutions, industrial storage operators, and agricultural facility owners seeking rapid-deployment, weather-resistant outdoor enclosures.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, dome shelters are broadly classified into geodesic domes (triangulated steel/aluminium frame with PVC or fabric cover), FRP domes (moulded fibre-reinforced plastic panels), polycarbonate domes (UV-resistant transparent/translucent panels), tensile domes (cable-supported membrane), and inflatable/air domes (PVC membrane, air-supported). The geodesic dome with galvanised steel frame and PVC-coated fabric cover is the dominant commercial form, widely manufactured by Indian suppliers in Jaipur, Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Pune, and Ahmedabad. Key Indian manufacturers include Geeta Industries (Nagpur), Bharat Tent Manufacturers (Jaipur), Tenso India (Bengaluru), Pashupati Tent, and Architractile. Standard commercial diameters range from 3m to 50m; custom spans up to 80m are available from specialist suppliers. The glamping and eco-resort segment is the fastest-growing application in India, driven by hospitality sector demand; industrial storage and institutional (school/event) use represent the largest volume segment. Buyers compare structures primarily on frame material (MS vs galvanised steel vs aluminium), cover material (PVC fabric vs FRP vs polycarbonate), diameter/span, wind and snow load ratings, and whether the structure is portable/relocatable or permanent. The term 'dome shed' is widely used in industrial/storage contexts; 'geodesic dome tent' is used in glamping/hospitality contexts. No specific BIS/IS standard governs dome shelters as a product category — structural design follows general IS codes for steel structures (IS 800) and fabric/tensile structures.
